description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing team event types, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting event types, and creating phone calls related to event types. It handles API endpoints under '/v2/teams/:teamId/event-types' with various methods and guards.

classes.name: TeamsEventTypesController
classes.description: NestJS controller for managing team event types, including CRUD operations and creating phone calls.

methods.name: createTeamEventType
methods.description: Creates a new team event type after transforming and validating input.

methods.name: getTeamEventType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific team event type by ID, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: createPhoneCall
methods.description: Creates a phone call related to an event type using handleCreatePhoneCall.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves list of team event types, optionally filtered by slug and sorted.

methods.name: updateTeamEventType
methods.description: Updates an existing team event type after transforming and validating input.

methods.name: deleteTeamEventType
methods.description: Deletes a team event type and returns its ID and title.
